{{Top|leg}}
The '''Adumari Union Council''' was a legislature body composed of [[perator]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. Its members also served as the collective [[Politics/Legends|head of state]] of the [[Adumari Union]]. The Adumari Union Council was formed in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] in the wake of the brief [[Adumari Civil War]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
